correctness.rationale: A circular word determines an Eulerian multigraph on vertices 00,01,10,11. Balance forces B=E=x,D=G=y,F=t-x,C=t-y and length n=A+H+x+y+2t. For x,y>0 a four-vertex directed circuit connects all nonzero edges; if exactly one is positive the absent-side isolated loop must vanish; x=y=0 permits a unary loop or pure alternation only. These disjoint connected-support cases parameterize profiles uniquely. Summing geometric series gives the submitted rational expression, with fifth-order pole coefficient 1/12 and n^4/288 asymptotic. Independent 2^n-word enumeration reproduced counts 2,3,4,6,8,13,18,27,38,53 at n=1..10; it is a check, not the all-n proof.
